import sys
import math

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 = map(int, data[:6])
    
    # side lengths
    a = math.hypot(x2 - x3, y2 - y3)  # opposite A
    b = math.hypot(x1 - x3, y1 - y3)  # opposite B
    c = math.hypot(x1 - x2, y1 - y2)  # opposite C
    
    # incenter coordinates
    cx = (a * x1 + b * x2 + c * x3) / (a + b + c)
    cy = (a * y1 + b * y2 + c * y3) / (a + b + c)
    
    # area using shoelace formula
    area = abs(x1*(y2 - y3) + x2*(y3 - y1) + x3*(y1 - y2)) / 2.0
    
    # semiperimeter
    s = (a + b + c) / 2.0
    
    # inradius
    r = area / s
    
    print(f"{cx:.15f} {cy:.15f} {r:.15f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

import sys
import math

def main():
    data = list(map(float, sys.stdin.read().strip().split()))
    if len(data) != 6:
        return

    x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 = data

    # Side lengths opposite to vertices A(x1,y1), B(x2,y2), C(x3,y3)
    a = math.hypot(x2 - x3, y2 - y3)
    b = math.hypot(x1 - x3, y1 - y3)
    c = math.hypot(x1 - x2, y1 - y2)

    perimeter = a + b + c

    # Incenter coordinates: weighted average by opposite side lengths
    cx = (a * x1 + b * x2 + c * x3) / perimeter
    cy = (a * y1 + b * y2 + c * y3) / perimeter

    # Triangle area via cross product
    area = abs((x2 - x1) * (y3 - y1) - (x3 - x1) * (y2 - y1)) / 2.0

    # Inradius: r = Area / semiperimeter = 2*Area / perimeter
    r = 2.0 * area / perimeter

    print(f"{cx:.10f} {cy:.10f} {r:.10f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
